messages:
iza: noticed a spike in fncall validation rejects for payments-ingest this morning. console shows hard errors but payloads are arrays not objects. customers are getting charged on fallback and product thinks we dropped requests.
tom: can you paste a sample?
iza: log: validator:error=invalid_shape details='expected object, got array' sample='[{"tx":"abc","amt":10}]'
marc: we rolled the stricter fncall validator to canary last night in us-west. fallback to cheaper model is enabled for strict rejects.
anya: billing currently attributes charge to final execution model. observability increments validation_reject on origin route, so charge and error counters don't match.
sylvie: proposal: add a 'soft-fallback' console state (amber) showing origin_route + billed_model + redacted sample, instead of full red error.
tom: also add telemetry tags: fallback_reason, origin_route, billed_model, coercion_applied, counted_for_billing. that will make dashboards sane.
marc: impl note: validator should emit reason codes and a suggested_coercion hint. adapters can opt-in to wrap array -> {items: array} when route policy permits.
anya: per-route config idea: fncall_shape_policy = [strict, soft, coerce]. default enterprise = soft. surface setting in route UI.
sylvie: rollout change: exclude soft/coercion events from auto-flip triggers; only fatal rejects and capacity fallbacks should cause auto-flip.
iza: action items: 1) telemetry tags (tom) 2) console soft-fallback state + popover (sylvie) 3) validator reason codes (marc) 4) adapter coercion opt-in (anya) 5) billing wording + legal (anya + finance).
deploy-bot: deploy 1741110000-fncall-validator-canary -> success (canary us-west)
iza: thanks team. if anyone sees >10% soft-fallback on a route before we ship, drop top 3 samples here and ping @eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
